title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - ConnectivityServiceOffering
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/ConnectivityServiceOffering. Connectivity Infrastructure services are made out of Physical, Link and Network services. Interconnection services between providers exist as a subclass of Network services. Subclass of InfrastructureServiceOffering per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the InfrastructureServiceOffering model and not repeated here. The source ontology marks this class as abstract, not intended for direct instantiation; concrete subtypes (e.g. PhysicalConnectivityServiceOffering, LinkConnectivityServiceOffering, NetworkConnectivityServiceOffering) are modeled as their own entities.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ConnectivityServiceOffering'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

connectivityConfiguration.description: Relationship. All possible provided connectivity parameters for this network connectivity service offering. Links to one or more ConnectivityConfiguration entities.

connectivityQoS.description: Relationship. Contractual performance values defined in the SLA. Links to a QoS entity.
